note: 时间线叙事：四个真实版本（0.13.0→0.16.0）与各自新增能力，日期取自 CHANGELOG。收尾卡用 keyvalue 给当前事实。

items.content: 从“排版字段”到“读者能做决定”，这条线记录的是同一个方向：让回答本身可以操作。

items.title: 章节与排版
items.desc: divider.label 章节分隔、text.display 开篇句、card.eyebrow 小引题、image.caption 图注。

items.title: 图解三件套
items.desc: icon、blocks、arrow 三个图元节点，配 card.flat 与 col.width，流程图不必再手写 svg 坐标。

items.title: 本地优先
items.desc: carousel、image-group、computed 计算字段、map 地点选择：浏览与计算都不再打断对话。

items.title: 决策与编辑
items.desc: compare 前后对比、choices 带代价的选项、editor 草稿、entity-card、popover、date-picker、segmented-control。

items.content: From layout fields to decisions the reader can actually make, the line records one direction: the reply itself becomes operable.

items.title: Chapters and type
items.desc: divider.label chapter breaks, text.display openers, card.eyebrow overlines, image.caption captions.

items.title: Three figure primitives
items.desc: icon, blocks and arrow join card.flat and col.width — flow diagrams no longer need hand-written SVG coordinates.

items.title: Local first
items.desc: carousel, image-group, computed fields and the map picker: browsing and calculation stop interrupting the conversation.

items.title: Decisions and editing
items.desc: compare before/after pairs, choices with per-option costs, editor drafts, entity-card, popover, date-picker and segmented-control.
